description: Land Acquisition - Heenapahuwa, Wellawaya D/S Division, Monaragala District - Badulupitiya, Badulla D/S Division, Badulla District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2047/15 of 28.11.2017 order No. 315 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and the legal process for taking possession of these lands. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
